rationale: The candidate is a near-verbatim structured extraction of the markdown. All sections—overview, topic map, key points, frameworks, examples, takeaways, claims, quotes, and compressed summary—are present and sensibly organized. Every string is supported by the reference; no invented claims or numbers were found. Quotes match verbatim, timestamps are correctly converted to seconds, and terminology/names are exact. Coverage includes all core topics, examples, and takeaways. Compression is high with no redundant restatement beyond the markdown's own structure.
